import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
data = pd.read_csv('validation_scores.csv')
thresholds = pd.read_csv('thresholds.csv')
contract = pd.read_csv('acceptance_contract.csv')
p = contract.iloc[0]
y = data['actual_label'].to_numpy()
scores = data['score'].to_numpy()
assert scores.shape == y.shape
positive = y == 1
negative = y == 0
# Supplied threshold protocol preserves probability representation and declared order.
predictions = [scores >= threshold for threshold in thresholds['threshold']]
tp_masks = [(y == 1) & pred for pred in predictions]
fp_masks = [(y == 0) & pred for pred in predictions]
fn_masks = [(y == 1) & ~pred for pred in predictions]
tn_masks = [(y == 0) & ~pred for pred in predictions]
count_masks = tp_masks + fp_masks + fn_masks + tn_masks
count_matrix = np.asarray(count_masks).T
# Axis handling is supplied; write the taught count operation below.
count_by_mask = lambda operation: operation(count_matrix, axis=0)
tp0 = tp_masks[0]
tp1 = tp_masks[1]
fp0 = fp_masks[0]
fp1 = fp_masks[1]
fn0 = fn_masks[0]
fn1 = fn_masks[1]
tn0 = tn_masks[0]
tn1 = tn_masks[1]
# Complete the following learner analysis lines; retain all scaffold statements.
tp0_count = None
tp1_count = None
fp0_count = None
fp1_count = None
fn0_count = None
fn1_count = None
tn0_count = None
tn1_count = None
counts = [tp0_count,tp1_count,fp0_count,fp1_count,fn0_count,fn1_count,tn0_count,tn1_count] if tp0_count is not None else None
records = []
if counts is not None:
    size = len(thresholds)
    for i,row in thresholds.iterrows():
        tp,fp,fn,tn = [int(counts[i+j*size]) for j in range(4)]
        neg,pos = fp+tn,fn+tp
        fpr,fnr = (fp/neg if neg else None),(fn/pos if pos else None)
        cost = p.deployment_negative_probability*fpr*p.cost_FP+p.deployment_positive_probability*fnr*p.cost_FN if fpr is not None and fnr is not None else None
        eligible = cost is not None and cost <= p.expected_cost_bound
        records.append({'threshold':row.threshold,'score_representation':row.score_representation,'TP':tp,'FP':fp,'FN':fn,'TN':tn,'FPR':fpr,'FNR':fnr,'expected_error_cost':cost,'eligible':eligible})
eligible_records = [r for r in records if r['eligible']]
selected = min(eligible_records,key=lambda r:r['expected_error_cost']) if eligible_records else None
result = {'records':records,'selected':selected,'retention':'Retain the selected threshold, probability representation and validation record unchanged; no protected-test access.'}

eligible = [r for r in records if r['eligible']]
